newsitem.title: USA: BellSouth Wireless in railroad crossing pact.
newsitem.headline: BellSouth Wireless in railroad crossing pact.

text.p: BellSouth Wireless Inc, a subsidiary of BellSouth Corp said on Friday it has agreements with Open Cellular Systems and Rural Cellular Corp to provide its Cellemetry Data Service to monitor railroad crossing signal equipment.
No terms of the agreements were disclosed.

The company said Open Cellular plans to trial the new service in Minnesota and Ohio starting in the second quarter of 1997. In Minnesota, the service will use Rural Cellular's cellular network to transmit information about railroad crossings in the area.

Cellemetry Data Service, a wireless technology developed by BellSouth, allows remote equipment to be managed through data communications over existing cellular networks. The service tells railroad officials of existing or potential problems at railroad crossing sites without expensive wiring or requiring a person to relay the information manually, the company said.
